en.t: Hadrian adopts Antoninus Pius as his successor
en.s: On February 25, 138, Emperor Hadrian adopted Antoninus Pius as his son and successor, on condition that Antoninus in turn adopt the future Marcus Aurelius and Lucius Verus.

zh.t: 哈德良收养安敦宁·毕尤，指定其为继承人
zh.s: 138年2月25日，罗马皇帝哈德良收养安敦宁·毕尤，指定他为继承人，条件是安敦宁也要收养后来的马可·奥勒留和卢基乌斯·维鲁斯。

en.t: Asti defeats Thomas II of Savoy at Montebruno
en.s: On February 25, 1255, forces from Asti defeated Thomas II of Savoy at Montebruno near Garzigliana, in present-day Italy. Thomas later took refuge in Turin, where he was captured.

zh.t: 阿斯蒂军队在蒙特布鲁诺击败萨伏依的托马斯二世
zh.s: 1255年2月25日，阿斯蒂军队在今意大利加尔齐利亚纳附近的蒙特布鲁诺击败萨伏依的托马斯二世。托马斯后来逃到都灵避难，在那里被俘。

en.s: On February 25, 1336, forces of the Teutonic Order attacked Pilėnai, in present-day Lithuania. Medieval accounts describe the defenders burning possessions and killing themselves, but these accounts and the site’s identification remain debated.

zh.t: 条顿骑士团进攻皮莱奈
zh.s: 1336年2月25日，条顿骑士团进攻今立陶宛境内的皮莱奈。中世纪记载称，守军焚烧财物并自尽，但这些叙述及遗址的具体位置仍存在争议。

en.t: New Netherland colonists massacre Munsee people near Manhattan
en.s: On February 25, 1643, soldiers and settlers of New Netherland attacked Munsee people sheltering at Corlears Hook and Pavonia, in the present-day United States. The killings of men, women and children ignited the conflict known as Kieft’s War.
en.n: The Dutch National Archives dates the massacres to the night of February 25. The original February 23 range start is corrected for this specific occurrence.

zh.t: 新尼德兰殖民者在曼哈顿一带屠杀门西人
zh.s: 1643年2月25日，新尼德兰的士兵和殖民者袭击在科利尔角和帕沃尼亚避难的门西人，地点位于今美国境内。妇女、儿童和男子均遭杀害，这两起屠杀引发了后来被称为“基夫特战争”的冲突。
zh.n: 荷兰国家档案馆将屠杀记为2月25日夜间，此处纠正原记录所写的2月23日。

en.t: Handel’s opera Nero opens in Hamburg
en.s: On February 25, 1705, George Frideric Handel’s opera Nero opened in Hamburg, in present-day Germany, with Johann Mattheson in the title role. It ran for only three performances.

zh.t: 亨德尔的歌剧《尼禄》在汉堡首演
zh.s: 1705年2月25日，乔治·弗里德里希·亨德尔的歌剧《尼禄》在今德国汉堡首演，由约翰·马特松饰演尼禄。该剧当时只演出了三场。

en.t: Fort Vincennes surrenders to George Rogers Clark
en.s: On February 25, 1779, British lieutenant governor Henry Hamilton surrendered Fort Vincennes to George Rogers Clark’s forces at Vincennes, in present-day Indiana, United States.

zh.t: 文森斯堡向乔治·罗杰斯·克拉克投降
zh.s: 1779年2月25日，英国副总督亨利·汉密尔顿在文森斯向乔治·罗杰斯·克拉克的部队交出文森斯堡，地点位于今美国印第安纳州。

en.s: The Action of 25 February 1781 was a small naval engagement which was fought off Cape Finisterre between a Spanish naval frigate sixth rate Graña of thirty guns and a Royal Naval fifth rate frigate HMS Cerberus of thirty two guns. The British were victorious when Graña surrendered after a hard fight. On 25 February 1781, whilst cruising twenty leagues off Cape Finisterre, the Royal Naval frigate HMS Cerberus of thirty two guns under Captain Robert Mann sighted the Spanish twenty gun frigate Graña, under Don Nicolás de Medina. Graña was a month out of Ferrol but had not had a successful cruise - capturing very little.

zh.s: 1781年2月25日，西班牙海军六级护卫舰“格拉尼亚”号与英国皇家海军五级护卫舰“刻耳柏洛斯”号，在菲尼斯特雷角外海交战。“格拉尼亚”号经激战后投降，英国获胜。当天，罗伯特·曼恩舰长指挥装有32门炮的“刻耳柏洛斯”号，在距海角约20里格处巡航，发现尼古拉斯·德梅迪纳指挥的西班牙舰。“格拉尼亚”号已离开费罗尔一个月，巡航战果很少。原文前后分别将该舰火炮数记为30门和20门。

en.s: The Battle of Valls was fought on 25 February 1809, during the Peninsular War between a French force under General Gouvion Saint-Cyr and a Spanish force under General Reding. Fought near the town of Valls in Catalonia Spain, the battle ended in a French victory. The Spanish commander, General Reding, was fatally wounded during a cavalry charge against French cavalry. During actions on the 15th of February 1809, Reding's left wing was cut off from reinforcement by a French attack. Reding, deciding to retrieve this cut off army, instead of counter striking at Souham.

zh.s: 1809年2月25日，半岛战争期间，古维翁·圣西尔将军率法军与雷丁将军指挥的西班牙军，在西班牙加泰罗尼亚巴利斯镇附近交战。法军获胜，雷丁在率骑兵冲击法国骑兵时受到致命伤。此前2月15日，法军袭击切断了雷丁左翼部队获得增援的通路。雷丁决定先救回这支被隔断的部队，而不是反击苏昂。原文在此处结束，末句不完整。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 25 February and 6 March 1824. The election was an overwhelming victory for Villèle and rightists, as only 17 MPs of the opposition were re-elected (including Royer-Collard, Cécile Stanilas de Girardin, Benjamin Constant and Maximilien Sébastien Foy).
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 法国于1824年2月25日和3月6日举行立法选举。维莱尔和右翼势力大获全胜，反对派中只有17名议员连任，其中包括罗耶-科拉尔、塞西尔·斯塔尼斯拉·德·吉拉尔丹、本雅明·贡斯当和马克西米连·塞巴斯蒂安·福瓦。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的首轮投票日期。

en.s: The Battle of Olszynka Grochowska, or the battle of Grochów, was fought on 25 February 1831 in the woods near Grochów, on the eastern outskirts of Warsaw. The Polish army, commanded by Józef Chłopicki, succeeded in preventing its Russian counterpart, under Hans Karl von Diebitsch, from crushing the uprising. However, the battle has also been described as an inconclusive bloodbath.

zh.s: 1831年2月25日，华沙东郊格罗胡夫附近的树林发生战斗，史称奥尔申卡格罗霍夫斯卡战役，也称格罗胡夫战役。约瑟夫·赫沃皮茨基指挥的波兰军队，成功阻止汉斯·卡尔·冯·迪比奇率领的俄军镇压起义。不过，此战也被形容为没有明确胜负的血战。

en.s: The Battle of Białołęka was fought from 24 to 25 February 1831 in the village of Białołęka, Poland, during the November Uprising. Though the Polish forces were victorious over the Russians, the outcome was not decisive, and was inconclusive in the scope of the larger Russo-Polish War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 比亚沃文卡战役于1831年2月24日至25日在波兰比亚沃沃卡村进行，是十一月起义的一部分。波兰军队虽然击败俄军，但战果并不决定性，对更大范围的俄波战争也没有决定性影响。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Samuel Colt receives a US patent for a revolving firearm
en.s: On February 25, 1836, Samuel Colt received a United States patent for his revolving firearm, later numbered 9430X. It followed his earlier British patent and preceded a separate US patent issued in August.

zh.t: 塞缪尔·柯尔特获得旋转弹膛枪械的美国专利
zh.s: 1836年2月25日，塞缪尔·柯尔特获得旋转弹膛枪械的美国专利，后来编号为9430X。在此之前他已取得英国专利，同年8月另有一项美国专利获批。

en.s: The Action of Sequalteplan, on February 25, 1848, was an American victory by a force under Gen. Joseph Lane that defeated a Mexican guerrilla force under Celedonio Dómeco de Jarauta at Zacualtipan. It was the last American expedition against the Mexican guerrillas of Central Mexico in the war.

zh.s: 1848年2月25日，约瑟夫·莱恩将军率领的美军在萨夸尔蒂潘击败塞莱多尼奥·多梅科·德·哈劳塔率领的墨西哥游击队。美军获胜。这是战争期间美军在墨西哥中部对付游击队的最后一次远征。

en.s: The Battle of Dioubouldou (sometimes spelled Jubuldu, Dioubouldy or Dybuldu) was fought on 25 February 1855 between French forces of Colonel Louis Faidherbe and the combined Waalo and Trarza forces under Queen Ndaté Yalla Mbodj.

zh.s: 1855年2月25日，路易·费代尔布上校率法国部队，与恩达泰·亚拉·姆博吉女王统率的瓦洛和特拉扎联军在迪乌布尔杜交战。这个地名也有朱布尔杜、迪乌布尔迪等拼写形式。

en.t: Hiram Revels is sworn in as the first African American US senator
en.s: On February 25, 1870, Hiram R. Revels of Mississippi was sworn in to the United States Senate in Washington, D.C. He became the first African American to serve in the US Congress.

zh.t: 海勒姆·雷韦尔斯宣誓成为美国首位非裔参议员
zh.s: 1870年2月25日，来自密西西比州的海勒姆·R.雷韦尔斯在华盛顿宣誓就任美国参议员，成为首位在美国国会任职的非裔人士。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 25 February 1872. Supporters of Alexandros Koumoundouros and Dimitrios Voulgaris both won 65 seats of the 190 seats. Voulgaris remained Prime Minister until 20 July, when he was replaced by Epameinondas Deligiorgis.

zh.s: 希腊于1872年2月25日举行议会选举。亚历山德罗斯·库蒙杜罗斯与季米特里奥斯·武尔加里斯的支持者，分别在190个议席中赢得65席。武尔加里斯继续担任首相，直到7月20日由埃帕米农达斯·德利约吉斯接替。

en.t: United States Steel Corporation is founded
en.s: On February 25, 1901, United States Steel Corporation was founded in the United States. Its formation combined major steel businesses, including Carnegie Steel and Federal Steel.

zh.s: 1901年2月25日，美国钢铁公司在美国成立，由包括卡内基钢铁公司和联邦钢铁公司在内的多家钢铁企业合并组建。

en.s: The Battle of Stanaford (February 25, 1903) was an armed raid against striking miners in the village of Stanaford, West Virginia, United States. It was the final episode of the 1902 New River Coal Strike. The raiding party was led by Deputy U.S. Marshall Daniel Webster Cunningham, Raleigh County Sheriff Harvey Cook, and Howard Smith of the Baldwin-Felts Detective Agency. Six miners were killed. The Labor Leader Mary Harris Jones saw the aftermath of the attack, writing in her autobiography: "I took the short trail up the hillside to Stanford Mountain.

zh.s: 1903年2月25日，美国西弗吉尼亚州斯塔纳福德村发生针对罢工矿工的武装突袭，是1902年新河煤矿罢工的最后一幕。突袭队由美国联邦副法警丹尼尔·韦伯斯特·坎宁安、罗利县警长哈维·库克，以及鲍德温—费尔茨侦探社的霍华德·史密斯率领，六名矿工被杀。劳工领袖玛丽·哈里斯·琼斯目睹事后景象，在自传中写道：“我沿着山坡上的小路，走向斯坦福山。”原文引用在此结束。

en.t: An armed posse clashes with Mike Daggett’s family at Kelley Creek
en.s: On February 25, 1911, an armed posse clashed with Mike Daggett and his Shoshone family at Kelley Creek in Nevada, United States. The encounter caused deaths on both sides; accounts do not establish who fired first.

zh.t: 武装追捕队与迈克·达格特一家在凯利溪交战
zh.s: 1911年2月25日，一支武装追捕队在美国内华达州凯利溪与肖肖尼人迈克·达格特一家交战，双方均有人死亡。现有记载无法确定哪一方先开枪。

en.s: The Capture of Trabzon refers to the military operation carried out by the reorganized Ottoman Third Army, under the command of Wehip Pasha, which resulted in the seizure of Trabzon from Russian control on February 24, 1918, during World War I.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1918年特拉布宗陷落指奥斯曼第三军在魏希卜帕夏指挥下重组并发动军事行动，于第一次世界大战期间从俄军手中夺取特拉布宗。该行动于1918年2月24日完成。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1920 Yukon general election was held on February 25, 1920, to elect the three members of the Yukon Territorial Council. The number of councilors was reduced from ten in the previous election to three following the general decline in population since the Klondike Gold Rush. The council held an advisory role to the federally appointed Commissioner.

zh.s: 育空地区于1920年2月25日举行大选，选出育空地区议会三名议员。由于克朗代克淘金热之后人口普遍减少，议员人数从上届选举的十人减至三人。议会负责提供咨询，专员由联邦政府任命。

en.s: The Coolavokig ambush (Irish: Luíochán Chúil an Bhuacaigh) was carried out by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) on 25 February 1921, during the Irish War of Independence. It took place at Coolavokig, on the road between Macroom and Ballyvourney, County Cork. A 60-man flying column of the IRA's 1st Cork Brigade under Seán O'Hegarty, ambushed a 70-man convoy of the Auxiliary Division under Major Seafield Grant, sparking a four-hour battle.

zh.s: 1921年2月25日，爱尔兰独立战争期间，爱尔兰共和军在科克郡麦克鲁姆与巴利沃尼之间公路上的库拉沃基格发动伏击。肖恩·奥赫加蒂率科克第一旅一支60人的机动纵队，伏击西菲尔德·格兰特少校指挥的70人警察辅助部队车队，双方交战四小时。

en.t: Soviet forces take Tbilisi and proclaim a Georgian Soviet republic
en.s: On February 25, 1921, the Red Army entered Tbilisi, Georgia, after heavy fighting. Bolshevik leaders proclaimed a Georgian Soviet Socialist Republic, while the invasion of the rest of Georgia continued.

zh.t: 苏军攻占第比利斯并宣布建立格鲁吉亚苏维埃共和国
zh.s: 1921年2月25日，红军在激战后进入格鲁吉亚首都第比利斯。布尔什维克领导人宣布成立格鲁吉亚苏维埃社会主义共和国，对格鲁吉亚其他地区的入侵仍在继续。

en.t: Hitler gains German citizenship through a Brunswick appointment
en.s: On February 25, 1932, Adolf Hitler gained German citizenship through an appointment to the Free State of Brunswick’s civil service. He had been stateless since giving up Austrian citizenship in 1925.

zh.t: 希特勒通过不伦瑞克的公职任命取得德国国籍
zh.s: 1932年2月25日，阿道夫·希特勒通过不伦瑞克自由邦的一项公职任命取得德国国籍。他自1925年放弃奥地利国籍后，一直没有国籍。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Estonia on 24 and 25 February 1938. The National Front for the Implementation of the Constitution was the only party to contest the election, and won 64 of the 80 seats. Of the 16 independents elected, six were members of the Democracy Group (composed of two former members of the National Centre Party, two Settlers and two of the Veterans' League), six of the Unity Group of Working People (composed of four leftist Socialists and two rightist Socialists), two were Independent Workers and two were members of the Russian Group.

zh.s: 爱沙尼亚于1938年2月24日至25日举行议会选举。贯彻宪法国民阵线是唯一参选政党，赢得80席中的64席。其余16名当选者以独立人士身份参选：6人属于民主小组，包括2名前国家中央党成员、2名垦殖者党成员和2名退伍军人联盟成员；6人属于劳动人民团结小组，包括4名左派社会党人和2名右派社会党人；另有2名独立工人派及2名俄罗斯人小组成员。

en.s: The 1938 Combined Scottish Universities by-election was a by-election held from 21 to 25 February 1938 for the Combined Scottish Universities, a university constituency of the British House of Commons.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1938年苏格兰大学联合选区补选
zh.s: 1938年苏格兰大学联合选区补选于2月21日至25日举行，选出英国下议院苏格兰大学联合选区议员。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Anderson air-raid shelters are delivered in Islington
en.s: On February 25, 1939, Anderson air-raid shelters were delivered to homes in Tiber Street, Islington, London, United Kingdom, before the outbreak of the Second World War.

zh.t: 安德森防空掩体运抵伦敦伊斯灵顿
zh.s: 1939年2月25日，安德森防空掩体运抵英国伦敦伊斯灵顿的泰伯街住宅区。此时第二次世界大战尚未爆发。

en.s: The February strike (Dutch: Februaristaking) of 1941 was a general strike in the Nazi-occupied Netherlands during World War II. It was organized by the outlawed Communist Party of the Netherlands in defence of persecuted Dutch Jews and against the anti-Jewish measures and the activities of Nazism in general. The direct causes were a series of arrests and pogroms held by the Germans in the Jewish neighbourhood of Amsterdam, the Jodenbuurt. It started on 25 February 1941 and lasted for two days.

zh.s: 1941年2月，纳粹占领下的荷兰发生总罢工，荷兰语称“二月罢工”（Februaristaking）。这场罢工由被取缔的荷兰共产党组织，旨在声援遭迫害的荷兰犹太人，反对德国的反犹措施和纳粹活动。直接导火索是德军在阿姆斯特丹犹太区一带连续逮捕和袭击犹太人。罢工于1941年2月25日开始，持续两天。

en.t: U-boat attacks on convoy ON 67 are called off
en.s: On February 25, 1942, German U-boats were ordered to stop attacking convoy ON 67 in the North Atlantic. The surviving ships reached Halifax on March 1.

zh.t: 德国潜艇停止攻击ON 67护航船队
zh.s: 1942年2月25日，德国潜艇接到命令，停止在北大西洋攻击ON 67护航船队。幸存船只于3月1日抵达哈利法克斯。

en.t: Manchester Merchant is torpedoed in convoy ON 166
en.s: On February 25, 1943, German submarine U-628 struck Manchester Merchant with two torpedoes in the North Atlantic during attacks on convoy ON 166.

zh.t: “曼彻斯特商人”号在ON 166护航途中遭鱼雷袭击
zh.s: 1943年2月25日，德国潜艇U-628在北大西洋向ON 166护航船队中的“曼彻斯特商人”号发射鱼雷，两枚击中船只。

en.s: Operation Argument, after the war dubbed Big Week, was a sequence of raids by the United States Army Air Forces and RAF Bomber Command from 20 to 25 February 1944, as part of the Combined Bomber Offensive against Nazi Germany. The objective of Operation Argument was to destroy aircraft factories in central and southern Germany in order to defeat the Luftwaffe before the Normandy landings during Operation Overlord were to take place later in 1944.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “大周行动”是美国陆军航空队和英国皇家空军轰炸机司令部于1944年2月20日至25日发动的一系列空袭，战后称为“大周”。这是盟军联合轰炸攻势的一部分，目标是摧毁德国中部和南部的飞机制造厂，以便在1944年诺曼底登陆前击败德国空军。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Troops arrest mutinous naval ratings at Calcutta harbour
en.s: On February 25, 1946, troops surrounded a frigate at Calcutta harbour, in present-day India, and arrested naval ratings who had refused orders during the Royal Indian Navy mutiny.

zh.t: 军队在加尔各答港逮捕参与兵变的海军水兵
zh.s: 1946年2月25日，军队包围停靠在今印度加尔各答港的一艘护卫舰，逮捕在皇家印度海军兵变中拒绝服从命令的水兵。

en.t: The Allied Control Council formally abolishes Prussia
en.s: On February 25, 1947, the Allied Control Council issued Law No. 46, formally abolishing Prussia as an administrative unit in Germany. The law was distinct from earlier steps that had already dismantled Prussia’s government.

zh.t: 盟国管制委员会正式废除普鲁士
zh.s: 1947年2月25日，盟国管制委员会颁布第46号法令，正式废除普鲁士这一德国行政单位。此前，普鲁士政府已被逐步撤销，这次法令与那些较早的措施不同。

en.t: Soviet authorities arrest Hungarian politician Béla Kovács
en.s: On February 25, 1947, Soviet authorities arrested Béla Kovács, a leader of Hungary’s Independent Smallholders’ Party, in Hungary. He was accused of organizing underground anti-Soviet groups and was later deported to the Soviet Union.

zh.t: 苏联当局逮捕匈牙利政治人物贝拉·科瓦奇
zh.s: 1947年2月25日，苏联当局在匈牙利逮捕独立小农党领导人贝拉·科瓦奇，指控他组织地下反苏团体。他后来被押往苏联。

en.s: On February 25, 1948, Czechoslovak president Edvard Beneš accepted the resignations of non-Communist ministers and appointed a government dominated by the Communists in Prague, in present-day Czechia.

zh.t: 贝奈斯接受由共产党主导的新政府
zh.s: 1948年2月25日，捷克斯洛伐克总统爱德华·贝奈斯接受非共产党部长的辞呈，并在今捷克布拉格任命由共产党主导的新政府。

en.t: The first Pan American Games open in Buenos Aires
en.s: On February 25, 1951, the first Pan American Games opened in Buenos Aires, Argentina. President Juan Perón opened the ceremony.

zh.t: 首届泛美运动会在布宜诺斯艾利斯开幕
zh.s: 1951年2月25日，首届泛美运动会在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯开幕，总统胡安·庇隆主持开幕仪式。

en.t: Egypt announces Nasser’s appointment as prime minister
en.s: On February 25, 1954, Egypt’s Revolutionary Command Council announced acceptance of Muhammad Naguib’s resignation and Gamal Abdel Nasser’s appointment as prime minister. A same-day US diplomatic telegram recorded the communiqué.

zh.t: 埃及宣布由纳赛尔出任总理
zh.s: 1954年2月25日，埃及革命指挥委员会宣布接受穆罕默德·纳吉布的辞呈，并任命贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔为总理。美国驻开罗使馆当天的电报记录了这项公告。

en.s: Elections to the Bombay Legislative Assembly were held on 25 February 1957. 1146 candidates contested for the 339 constituencies in the Assembly. There were 57 two-member constituencies and 282 single-member constituencies. The incumbent Indian National Congress won reelection, with Yashwantrao Chavan continuing as Chief Minister. Despite suffering a decrease in seats, the incumbent government retained its simple majority in the legislative assembly.

zh.s: 印度孟买邦于1957年2月25日举行议会选举，1146名候选人角逐339个选区，其中57个选区各选出两名议员，282个选区各选出一名。执政的印度国民大会党获胜，亚什万特拉奥·恰万继续担任首席部长。尽管议席减少，政府仍在邦议会保有简单多数。

en.t: Nobusuke Kishi formally becomes prime minister of Japan
en.s: On February 25, 1957, Nobusuke Kishi formally became prime minister of Japan after Tanzan Ishibashi’s resignation. Kishi had previously served in an acting capacity.

zh.t: 岸信介正式就任日本首相
zh.s: 1957年2月25日，石桥湛山辞职后，岸信介正式就任日本首相。此前，岸信介已代理首相职务。

en.s: The 1961 Paddington-Waverley state by-election was held on 25 February 1961 to elect the member for Paddington-Waverley in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly, following the death of Labor Party MP William Ferguson. Labor candidate Keith Anderson was elected with a 28.7% primary vote swing in his favour. The only other candidate was Edward Maher from the Communist Party, who received 9.64% of the vote.

zh.t: 1961年帕丁顿—韦弗利州议席补选
zh.s: 新南威尔士州立法议会帕丁顿—韦弗利选区于1961年2月25日举行补选，起因是工党议员威廉·弗格森去世。工党候选人基思·安德森当选，其初选得票率增加28.7个百分点。另一名候选人是共产党人爱德华·马赫，得票率为9.64%。

en.s: General elections were held in India between 19 and 25 February 1962 to elect members of the third Lok Sabha. Unlike the previous two elections, each constituency elected a single member. Jawaharlal Nehru won another landslide victory in his third and final election campaign. The Indian National Congress received 44.7% of the vote and won 361 of the 494 elected seats.

zh.s: 印度于1962年2月19日至25日举行大选，选出第三届人民院议员。与前两届不同，这次每个选区只选出一名议员。贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁在第三次、也是最后一次大选竞选中，再度取得压倒性胜利。印度国民大会党获得44.7%的选票，在494个民选议席中赢得361席。

en.s: General elections were held in Western Samoa on 25 February 1967. All candidates ran as independents and voting was restricted to Faʻamatai and citizens of European origin ("individual voters"), with the Matai electing 45 MPs and Europeans two. Following the election, Fiamē Mataʻafa Faumuina Mulinuʻu II remained Prime Minister.

zh.s: 西萨摩亚于1967年2月25日举行大选。所有候选人均以独立人士身份参选。只有传统首领制度中的马泰，以及被称为“个人选民”的欧洲裔公民有投票权；马泰选出45名议员，欧洲裔选民选出2名。选举后，菲亚梅·马塔阿法·福穆伊纳·穆利努乌二世继续担任总理。

en.s: General elections were held in Senegal on 25 February 1968 to elect a President and National Assembly. After a series of party mergers, the country had become a one-party state, with the Senegalese Progressive Union (UPS) as the sole legal party, As a result, its leader, Léopold Sédar Senghor, was the only candidate in the presidential election and was re-elected unopposed. In the National Assembly election, voters were presented with a list of 80 UPS candidates to vote for. Voter turnout was 94.7% in the presidential election and 93.0% in the National Assembly election.

zh.s: 塞内加尔于1968年2月25日举行总统及国民议会选举。经过一系列政党合并，该国已成为一党制国家，塞内加尔进步联盟是唯一合法政党。因此，党魁利奥波德·塞达尔·桑戈尔成为唯一总统候选人，无竞争地连任。国民议会选举则让选民对一份包含80名进步联盟候选人的名单投票。总统选举投票率为94.7%，国民议会选举为93.0%。

en.t: Manipur’s assembly election reaches its final polling day
en.s: On February 25, 1974, Manipur, India, held the final stated polling day of its legislative assembly election, whose polling period ran from February 19 to 25.

zh.t: 曼尼普尔邦议会选举进入最后一天投票
zh.s: 1974年2月25日，印度曼尼普尔邦议会选举进入资料所载的最后一天投票。这次投票从2月19日持续到25日。

en.s: The first elections to the Arunachal Pradesh Legislative Assembly were held in on February 25, 1978. There were 30 single-member constituencies at the time of the election, out of whom two were reserved for Scheduled Tribes. There was a total of 86 candidates participating. The maximum number of candidates was found in the Ziro constituency, with six candidates. In two constituencies (Prem Khandu Thungan from Dirang, Kalaktang and Noksong Boham from Niasua-Kanubari) there was only one candidate, who was elected unopposed. There were 29 Janata Party candidates, 21 People's Party of Arunachal candidates, 1 Indian National Congress candidate(shri Tasso Grayu) and 35 independents in the fray.

zh.s: 阿鲁纳恰尔邦于1978年2月25日举行首次议会选举。当时有30个单议席选区，其中2席为表列部落保留，共86名候选人参选。济罗选区候选人最多，共6人。两个选区只有一名候选人，迪朗—卡拉克唐的普雷姆·坎杜·通贡，以及尼亚苏阿—卡努巴里的诺克松·博哈姆均不战而胜。参选者包括29名人民党候选人、21名阿鲁纳恰尔人民党候选人、1名印度国民大会党候选人塔索·格拉尤，以及35名独立人士。

en.s: The 1978 Meghalaya Legislative Assembly election was held on 25 February 1978. No party secured a majority of seats in the election. Following negotiations, a coalition government, known as the Meghalaya United Legislative Party, was formed between the All Party Hill Leaders Conference, the Hill State People's Democratic Party and the Public Demands Implementation Convention (PDIC).

zh.s: 印度梅加拉亚邦于1978年2月25日举行议会选举，没有政党取得过半数议席。谈判后，山地领袖全民会议、山地邦人民民主党及公众诉求落实大会组成联合政府，称为“梅加拉亚联合立法党团”。

en.s: The 1978 Assam Legislative Assembly election was held to elect members for 126 assembly seats to constitute the seventh Assam Legislative Assembly on February 25 1978. The Janata Party formed the first non-Congress government led by Golap Borbora with 53 seats on March 12, 1978. He resigned as chief minister on September 4, 1979 after losing the support of a majority of MLAs.

zh.s: 印度阿萨姆邦于1978年2月25日举行选举，选出第七届邦议会126名议员。人民党赢得53席，于3月12日组成首个非国大党政府，由戈拉普·博尔博拉领导。1979年9月4日，他因失去多数议员支持而辞去首席部长职务。

en.t: Andhra Pradesh elects its legislative assembly
en.s: On February 25, 1978, Andhra Pradesh, India, held its legislative assembly election. The Indian National Congress (Indira) won 175 of the 294 seats.

zh.t: 安得拉邦举行议会选举
zh.s: 1978年2月25日，印度安得拉邦举行议会选举。印度国民大会党（英迪拉派）赢得294个议席中的175席。

en.t: Maharashtra votes in its legislative assembly election
en.s: On February 25, 1978, Maharashtra, India, voted in its legislative assembly election. All 288 seats were contested. Government formation followed the election.

zh.t: 马哈拉施特拉邦举行议会选举投票
zh.s: 1978年2月25日，印度马哈拉施特拉邦举行议会选举投票，争夺全部288个席位。组建政府是在选举之后进行的。

en.s: The Surinamese coup d'état of 1980, usually referred to as the Sergeants' Coup (Dutch: De Sergeantencoup), occurred on 25 February 1980, when a group of 16 sergeants (Dutch: groep van zestien) led by Dési Bouterse overthrew the government of Prime Minister Henck Arron with a violent coup d'état. This marked the beginning of the military dictatorship that dominated Suriname from 1980 until 1991. The dictatorship featured the presence of an evening curfew, the lack of freedom of press, a ban on political parties (from 1985), a restriction on the freedom of assembly, a high level of government corruption and the summary executions of political opponents.

zh.s: 1980年2月25日，德西·鲍特瑟率16名军士发动暴力政变，推翻亨克·阿龙总理的政府，通常被称为“军士政变”。此事开启了1980年至1991年支配苏里南的军事独裁时期。其统治特征包括晚间宵禁、压制新闻自由、从1985年起禁止政党活动、限制集会自由、政府严重腐败，以及未经正常司法程序处决政治对手。

en.s: General elections were held in Pakistan on 25 February 1985 to elect members of the National Assembly. The elections were held under the military government of Muhammad Zia-ul-Haq after the restoration of the 1973 constitution. Around 1,300 candidates contested the elections, which were held on a nonpartisan basis. Each candidate was required to have their nomination paper signed by 50 registered voters from the constituency they wished to stand in.

zh.s: 巴基斯坦于1985年2月25日举行大选，选出国民议会议员。选举在穆罕默德·齐亚·哈克军政府恢复1973年宪法后举行，采用不以党派名义参选的方式，共约1300名候选人角逐。每名候选人的提名文件，都须由拟参选选区的50名登记选民签名。

en.s: General elections were held in Islamabad Capital Territory on Monday, 25 February 1985, to elect one member of the National Assembly of Pakistan for the constituency NA-35 representing Islamabad. Independent politician Mohammad Nawaz Khokhar won the seat.

zh.t: 1985年巴基斯坦大选伊斯兰堡选区结果
zh.s: 1985年2月25日星期一，巴基斯坦伊斯兰堡首都区举行大选，为代表伊斯兰堡的NA-35选区选出一名国民议会议员。独立候选人穆罕默德·纳瓦兹·科卡尔当选。

en.s: The 36th annual Berlin International Film Festival was held 14–25 February 1986. The festival opened with Ginger and Fred by Federico Fellini, which played out of competition at the festival. The Golden Bear was awarded to West German film Stammheim directed by Reinhard Hauff. The retrospective was in honour of German actress and film producer Henny Porten and the homage was dedicated to American film director Fred Zinnemann.

zh.s: 第36届柏林国际电影节于1986年2月14日至25日举行。电影节以费德里科·费里尼执导的《姜戈与弗雷德》开幕，该片在非竞赛单元放映。赖因哈德·豪夫执导的西德电影《施塔姆海姆》获金熊奖。回顾展向德国女演员兼制片人亨尼·波滕致敬，致敬单元则聚焦美国导演弗雷德·金尼曼。

en.t: Marcos leaves Malacañang Palace as his rule collapses
en.s: On February 25, 1986, Ferdinand Marcos and his family left Malacañang Palace in Manila, Philippines, and were taken by helicopter to Clark Air Base. Their onward journey to exile followed, while Corazon Aquino assumed the presidency.

zh.t: 马科斯离开马拉卡南宫
zh.s: 1986年2月25日，费迪南德·马科斯及家人离开菲律宾马尼拉的马拉卡南宫，乘直升机前往克拉克空军基地，随后踏上流亡之路。科拉松·阿基诺于同日就任总统。

en.t: Corazon Aquino is sworn in as Philippine president
en.s: On February 25, 1986, Corazon Aquino was sworn in as president of the Philippines during the People Power Revolution. Ferdinand Marcos left power that day.

zh.t: 科拉松·阿基诺宣誓就任菲律宾总统
zh.s: 1986年2月25日，科拉松·阿基诺在人民力量革命期间宣誓就任菲律宾总统。费迪南德·马科斯于同日下台。

en.t: Nigeria completes its “Miracle of Dammam” comeback
en.s: On February 25, 1989, Nigeria’s under-20 football team came back from 4–0 down against the Soviet Union in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, levelled the match at 4–4 and won the penalty shootout in the World Youth Championship quarter-final.

zh.t: 尼日利亚青年队完成“达曼奇迹”逆转
zh.s: 1989年2月25日，尼日利亚20岁以下足球队在沙特阿拉伯达曼举行的世界青年锦标赛四分之一决赛中，从0比4落后追成4比4，并在点球大战中击败苏联队。这场比赛被称为“达曼奇迹”。

en.s: WrestleWar '90: Wild Thing was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event, produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW) under the National Wrestling Alliance (NWA) banner. It took place on February 25, 1990, from the Greensboro Coliseum in Greensboro, North Carolina. This would be the second year in a row WCW promoted a PPV under the name "WrestleWar", a series that would include four shows in total.

zh.s: “摔角战争1990：狂野本色”是世界冠军摔角联盟（WCW）以全国摔角联盟（NWA）名义举办的职业摔角按次付费赛事，于1990年2月25日在北卡罗来纳州格林斯伯勒体育馆举行。这是WCW连续第二年以“摔角战争”为名举办按次付费赛事，该系列最终共举行四届。

en.t: On 25 February 1991, at a meeting in Hungary, the pact ceased to exist via joint declaration by the defence and foreign ministers of the six remaining member states
en.s: The Warsaw Pact (WP), formally the Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance (TFCMA), was a collective defence treaty signed in Warsaw, Poland, between the Soviet Union and seven other Eastern Bloc socialist republics in Central and Eastern Europe in May 1955, during the Cold War. The term "Warsaw Pact" commonly refers to both the treaty itself and its resultant military alliance, the Warsaw Pact Organisation (WPO; also known as the Warsaw Treaty Organization, WTO).

zh.s: 1991年2月25日，六个仍留在华沙条约组织的成员国国防部长和外交部长在匈牙利开会，并发表联合声明，宣布该组织解散。《华沙条约》（正式名称为《友好合作互助条约》）是苏联与东欧七个社会主义共和国于1955年5月在波兰华沙签署的集体防御条约。“华沙条约”一词通常既指条约本身，也指由此成立的军事联盟。

en.s: General elections were held in Fiji between 18 and 25 February 1994. This election, the second since Fiji had become a republic following two military coups in 1987, was brought about by splits within the ruling Soqosoqo ni Vakavulewa ni Taukei (SVT) and by the withdrawal of the support of the Fiji Labour Party, which claimed that Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabuka had reneged on a deal to review Fiji's electoral system, which was heavily weighted in favour of ethnic Fijians, despite their being nearly equal in number to Indo-Fijians.

zh.s: 斐济于1994年2月18日至25日举行大选。这是1987年两次军事政变、斐济成为共和国后的第二次选举。执政的斐济政治党内部出现分裂，斐济工党也撤回支持，促成此次投票。工党指责总理西蒂韦尼·兰布卡没有履行检讨选举制度的协议。当时制度明显偏向斐济原住民，尽管他们与印度裔斐济人口几乎相等。

en.s: On 25 February 1994, Baruch Goldstein, an American-Israeli physician and member of the far-right ultra-Zionist Kach movement, carried out a mass shooting of Palestinians who were praying in the Ibrahimi Mosque (Cave of the Patriarchs) in Hebron. Goldstein, dressed in Israeli army uniform, opened fire with an assault rifle and killed 29 people, including children as young as 12, and wounded 125 others.

zh.s: 1994年2月25日，美国裔以色列医生、极右翼犹太复国主义组织卡赫成员巴鲁克·戈尔茨坦在希伯伦的易卜拉欣清真寺（族长洞）向正在礼拜的巴勒斯坦人开枪。他身穿以色列军装，使用突击步枪，杀害29人，其中包括年仅12岁的儿童，并造成125人受伤。

en.s: In professional wrestling, Return of the Funker was a supercard held by the Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States-based professional wrestling promotion Extreme Championship Wrestling on February 25, 1995. The commentator for the event was Joey Styles. Several of the bouts were broadcast on the February 28, March 7 and March 14 episodes of ECW Hardcore TV. The event was named for Terry Funk, who returned to ECW at the end of the event.

zh.s: “芬克归来”是位于美国宾夕法尼亚州费城的极限冠军摔角联盟（ECW），于1995年2月25日举办的大型职业摔角赛事，由乔伊·斯泰尔斯解说。部分比赛在2月28日、3月7日及3月14日的《ECW硬核电视》节目中播出。赛事以特里·芬克命名，他在活动尾声重返ECW。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Equatorial Guinea on 25 February 1996. Although the country was no longer a one-party state, the elections were boycotted by the opposition, although their names remained on the ballot papers. As a result, the incumbent Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo won with 97.85% of votes. Turnout was 79.8%.

zh.s: 赤道几内亚于1996年2月25日举行总统选举。该国虽已不再是一党制，反对派仍抵制选举，但他们的姓名依旧列在选票上。现任总统特奥多罗·奥比昂·恩圭马·姆巴索戈因此以97.85%的选票获胜。投票率为79.8%。

en.s: The 1997 Tallahassee mayoral election was held on February 4 and February 25, 1997, to elect the Mayor of Tallahassee, Florida. It was the first election since 1919 that the post of the mayor was directly elected. Incumbent mayor Scott Maddox was elected by the City Commission to serve as the mayor of Tallahassee in 1995. Following November 1996 referendum where citizens of Tallahassee approved popular elections for mayors.

zh.s: 1997年2月4日和25日，佛罗里达州塔拉哈西举行市长选举，这是自1919年以来首次由选民直接选出市长。现任市长斯科特·马多克斯原于1995年由市委员会选任。1996年11月，当地公投通过改为民选市长，随后举行此次选举。

en.s: Minerva Airlines Flight 1553, was a regularly scheduled commercial passenger flight from Cagliari to Genoa operated by Minerva Airlines under the Alitalia Express brand via a codeshare agreement with Alitalia. On 25 February 1999, the Dornier 328 serving the flight lost control and overran the runway while landing at Genoa Cristoforo Colombo Airport. Of the 31 occupants on board, three died, including the flight attendant; another passenger later died in hospital.

zh.s: 米内瓦航空1553号班机是一条从卡利亚里飞往热那亚的定期商业客运航线，由米内瓦航空运营，并通过代码共享协议使用意大利航空快运品牌。1999年2月25日，该航班的多尼尔328飞机在热那亚克里斯托弗·哥伦布机场降落时失控并冲出跑道。机上31人中有三人死亡，包括一名乘务员；另有一名乘客后来在医院死亡。

en.s: The 2001 No Way Out was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the third No Way Out and took place on February 25, 2001, at the Thomas & Mack Center in the Las Vegas suburb of Paradise, Nevada. The show is widely considered to be one of the greatest WWE pay-per-views of all time.

zh.s: “无路可逃2001”是世界摔角联盟（WWF，现为WWE）举办的职业摔角按次付费赛事，也是该系列的第三届。赛事于2001年2月25日在内华达州拉斯维加斯郊区帕拉代斯的托马斯和马克中心举行，广被视为WWE历来最出色的按次付费赛事之一。

en.s: The 2001 Football League Cup final was a football match played between Birmingham City and Liverpool on 25 February 2001 at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff. It was the final match of the 2000–01 Football League Cup, the 41st season of the Football League Cup, a football competition for the 92 teams in the Premier League and the English Football League.

zh.s: 2001年英格兰联赛杯决赛于2001年2月25日在卡迪夫千禧球场举行，由伯明翰城对阵利物浦。这是2000—2001赛季英格兰联赛杯的决赛，该项赛事由英超和英格兰足球联赛的92支球队参加。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Cape Verde on 11 February 2001, with a second round on 25 February after no candidate achieved outright victory in the first round. The result was a victory for Pedro Pires of the African Party for the Independence of Cape Verde, who defeated Carlos Veiga of the Movement for Democracy by just 17 votes. This makes it one of the closest elections results in history.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 佛得角于2001年2月11日举行总统选举，由于首轮没有候选人获得绝对多数，2月25日举行第二轮。佛得角独立非洲党候选人佩德罗·皮雷斯获胜，以仅17票之差击败争取民主运动候选人卡洛斯·维加。这是历史上差距最小的选举之一。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Kiribati on 25 February 2003. The result was a victory for incumbent President Teburoro Tito, who received 50% of the vote. However, Tito was removed from office following a vote of no confidence in the House of Assembly in March 2003, and fresh elections were held in July.

zh.s: 基里巴斯于2003年2月25日举行总统选举。现任总统特布罗罗·蒂托以50%的选票获胜，但在3月议会不信任投票后被免职，7月又重新举行选举。

en.s: The 2003 Orlando mayoral special election took place on February 25, 2003, following a primary election on February 4, 2003. Mayor Glenda Hood, who was last elected in 2000, resigned following her nomination as Secretary of State of Florida, triggering a special election. Eight candidates ran in the special election, the largest number of candidates in city history.

zh.s: 2003年奥兰多市长特别选举于2月25日举行，此前于2月4日进行初选。格伦达·胡德市长在2000年最近一次当选，后获提名出任佛罗里达州州务卿并辞职，因此举行特别选举。共有八名候选人参选，是该市历史上最多的一次。

en.s: The 2003 Tallahassee mayoral special election was held February 4 and February 25, 2003 to elect the mayor of Tallahassee, Florida. Since no candidate obtained a majority of the vote in the first-round, a runoff was held between the top-two finishers. The election coincided with elections to City Commissioner Seats 1, 2, 3 and 5. Marks became the second popularly elected mayor of Tallahassee.

zh.s: 佛罗里达州塔拉哈西于2003年2月4日和25日举行市长特别选举。首轮无人获得过半数选票，因此由前两名进入第二轮。选举与市委员会第1、2、3及5号席位的选举同时进行。马克斯获胜，成为塔拉哈西第二位由选民直接选出的市长。

en.t: Richard M. Daley wins another Chicago mayoral election
en.s: On February 25, 2003, Richard M. Daley won his fifth Chicago mayoral election in the United States. He received a majority in all 50 city wards.

zh.t: 理查德·M.戴利再次赢得芝加哥市长选举
zh.s: 2003年2月25日，理查德·M.戴利第五次赢得美国芝加哥市长选举，并在全市50个选区均获得过半选票。

en.t: Wichita holds its mayoral primary election
en.s: On February 25, 2003, Wichita, Kansas, United States, held the primary for its mayoral election. The general election followed on April 1.

zh.t: 威奇托举行市长选举初选
zh.s: 2003年2月25日，美国堪萨斯州威奇托举行市长选举初选，正式选举随后于4月1日举行。

en.s: The 2003 Kansas City mayoral election was held February 25 and March 31, 2003 to elect the mayor of Kansas City, Missouri. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Kay Barnes.
en.n: This entry records the primary, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 堪萨斯城于2003年2月25日和3月31日举行市长选举。凯·巴恩斯再次当选市长。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的初选日期。

en.s: The 2006 Xerox Super Cup was held on 25 February 2006 between the 2005 J. League champions Gamba Osaka and the 2005 Emperor's Cup winner Urawa Red Diamonds. Urawa won the Trophy after winning the match 3–1.

zh.s: 2006年施乐超级杯于2006年2月25日举行，由2005年J联赛冠军大阪钢巴对阵2005年天皇杯冠军浦和红钻。浦和以3比1获胜，夺得冠军。

en.s: Fiesta Lucha was a professional wrestling event held on February 25, 2007 at the Orleans Arena in Paradise, Nevada. Promoted by NWA Pro Wrestling, the event was the follow-up to the ground-breaking Wrestling Summit which mixed American professional wrestling with Mexican lucha libre. The event was the kick-off to a tour that included: Phoenix, Arizona; Kissimmee, Florida; Hammond, Indiana and several stops in Texas including Houston, El Paso, McAllen, Laredo, Hidalgo and Corpus Christi.

zh.s: “摔角嘉年华”是NWA职业摔角于2007年2月25日在内华达州帕拉代斯的奥尔良竞技场举办的赛事，承接此前开创性地结合美国职业摔角与墨西哥自由式摔角的“摔角峰会”。它也是一轮巡演的首站，后续地点包括亚利桑那州菲尼克斯、佛罗里达州基西米、印第安纳州哈蒙德，以及得克萨斯州的休斯敦、埃尔帕索、麦卡伦、拉雷多、伊达尔戈和科珀斯克里斯蒂。

en.s: A presidential election was held in Senegal on 25 February 2007. The incumbent president, Abdoulaye Wade, who was first elected in 2000, won the election in the first round with almost 56% of the vote.

zh.s: 塞内加尔于2007年2月25日举行总统选举。2000年首次当选的现任总统阿卜杜拉耶·瓦德，在首轮以接近56%的选票获胜。

en.s: The 2007 Football League Cup final was a football match between Chelsea and Arsenal on 25 February 2007 at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff. It was the final match of the 2006–07 staging of the Football League Cup, and last to be staged at the Millennium Stadium. Chelsea were making their fifth League Cup final appearance to Arsenal's sixth. Each club needed to get past four rounds to reach the final.

zh.s: 2007年英格兰联赛杯决赛于2007年2月25日在卡迪夫千禧球场举行，由切尔西对阵阿森纳。这是2006—2007赛季英格兰联赛杯决赛，也是该项赛事最后一次在千禧球场举行。切尔西第五次闯入联赛杯决赛，阿森纳则是第六次。两队都需要通过四轮比赛才能进入决赛。

en.t: Lee Myung-bak takes office as South Korean president
en.s: On February 25, 2008, Lee Myung-bak took the oath of office as president of South Korea.

zh.t: 李明博宣誓就任韩国总统
zh.s: 2008年2月25日，李明博宣誓就任韩国总统。

en.s: The Bangladesh Rifles revolt, also known as the Pilkhana massacre or Pilkhana tragedy, was a mutiny that took place on 25–26 February 2009 in Dhaka, when a group of Bangladesh Rifles (BDR) personnel seized the force's headquarters in Pilkhana. The mutineers killed Director General Shakil Ahmed, 56 other army officers and 17 civilians; fired on bystanders; held officers and their families hostage; and looted and vandalised property. Unrest later spread to several other cities before the rebels surrendered following negotiations with the government. In 2013, a Dhaka court convicted hundreds of accused BDR personnel in what international human rights organisations criticised as an unfair mass trial.

zh.s: 2009年2月25日至26日，孟加拉国步枪队部分人员占领达卡皮尔卡纳总部，发动兵变，又称皮尔卡纳惨案或悲剧。叛变者杀害总局长沙基勒·艾哈迈德、另外56名军官及17名平民，向路人开枪，劫持军官及其家属，并抢掠、毁坏财物。骚乱后来扩散至其他数座城市，叛变者与政府谈判后投降。2013年，达卡一家法院判定数百名被告步枪队人员有罪；国际人权组织批评这是不公正的集体审判。

en.s: Turkish Airlines Flight 1951 (also known as the Poldercrash or the Schiphol Polderbaan incident) was a passenger flight that crashed during landing at Amsterdam Schiphol Airport, the Netherlands, on 25 February 2009, resulting in the deaths of nine passengers and crew, including all three pilots. The aircraft, a Turkish Airlines Boeing 737-800, crashed into a field about 1.5 km (0.9 mi) north of the Polderbaan runway (18R), prior to crossing the A9 motorway inbound, at 09:26 UTC (10:26 CET), having flown from Istanbul, Turkey.

zh.t: 土耳其航空1951号班机空难
zh.s: 2009年2月25日，土耳其航空1951号班机在荷兰阿姆斯特丹史基浦机场降落过程中坠毁，造成9名乘客及机组人员死亡，包括全部三名飞行员。这起事故也称圩田空难或史基浦波尔德跑道事故。飞机是一架从土耳其伊斯坦布尔飞来的波音737-800，于协调世界时9时26分、欧洲中部时间10时26分，在进近时尚未越过A9高速公路，便坠入18R波尔德跑道以北约1.5公里、即0.9英里的田地。

en.s: The 2011 Irish general election took place on 25 February 2011 to elect the 166 members of Dáil Éireann, the lower house of Ireland's parliament, the Oireachtas. Held amid a sharp economic downturn and the eurozone crisis, the election swept Fianna Fáil from power on one of the largest swings in Europe since 1945 and resulted in a Fine Gael–Labour Party coalition with a record majority.

zh.s: 爱尔兰于2011年2月25日举行大选，选出议会下院众议院的166名议员。选举正值经济急剧下滑和欧元区危机，共和党在欧洲自1945年以来幅度最大的一次选票转移中失去政权。统一党与工党随后组成联合政府，取得创纪录的多数优势。

en.s: MFC 28: Supremacy was a mixed martial arts event held by the Maximum Fighting Championship (MFC) on February 25, 2011 at the River Cree Casino in Enoch, Alberta.

zh.s: MFC 28：巅峰对决是一场综合格斗赛事，由最大格斗锦标赛（MFC）于2011年2月25日在阿尔伯塔省埃诺克的河溪赌场举行。

en.s: The 2011 African Nations Championship final was a football match to determine the champions of the CHAN 2011 tournament and took place on 25 February 2011 the match was contested by Tunisia and Angola. Tunisia defeated Angola by 3–0, Tunisia winning their first title. Before this match the two teams met in the group stages and it finished 1–1.

zh.s: 2011年非洲国家锦标赛决赛于2011年2月25日举行，决出本届赛事冠军。突尼斯对阵安哥拉，最终以3比0获胜，首次夺冠。两队此前曾在小组赛中交手，战成1比1。

en.t: Fighting between Naga factions continues into February 25
en.s: On February 25, 2011, fighting between rival factions of the National Socialist Council of Nagaland continued in Tirap district, India, after an ambush the previous night. Reports of the incident emerged later.

zh.t: 那加兰武装派别在蒂拉普的交战持续到25日
zh.s: 2011年2月25日，那加兰民族社会主义委员会两个派别在印度蒂拉普地区的交战仍在继续，起因是前一天夜间的伏击。有关这次冲突的报道在后来才出现。

en.s: The 2012 Cross River State gubernatorial election occurred in Nigeria on February 25, 2012. The PDP nominee Liyel Imoke won the election, defeating Usani Uguru Usani of the ACN. Liyel Imoke emerged as PDP candidate. He picked Efiok Cobham as his running mate. Usani Uguru Usani was the ACN candidate.

zh.s: 尼日利亚克罗斯河州于2012年2月25日举行州长选举。人民民主党候选人利耶尔·伊莫克击败尼日利亚行动大会的乌萨尼·乌古鲁·乌萨尼，当选州长。伊莫克选择埃菲奥克·科巴姆为副手。

en.s: The 2012 Chinese FA Super Cup (Chinese: 2012中国足球协会超级杯) was the 10th Chinese Football Super Cup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Super League and FA Cup competitions. The match was played at the Guangzhou University City Stadium on 25 February 2012, and contested by league winner Guangzhou Evergrande and cup winner Tianjin Teda. Guangzhou Evergrande won the title 2–1.

zh.s: 2012年中国足协超级杯（中文：2012中国足球协会超级杯）是第十届中国足球超级杯，由上赛季中超联赛和足协杯冠军对阵。比赛于2012年2月25日在广州大学城体育中心举行，由联赛冠军广州恒大对阵足协杯冠军天津泰达。广州恒大以2比1获胜。

en.t: Maghreb de Fès wins the CAF Super Cup on penalties
en.s: On February 25, 2012, Maghreb de Fès defeated Espérance de Tunis 4–3 on penalties after a 1–1 draw to win the CAF Super Cup in Radès, Tunisia.

zh.t: 费斯马格里布通过点球大战赢得非洲超级杯
zh.s: 2012年2月25日，费斯马格里布在突尼斯拉德斯举行的非洲超级杯中，与突尼斯希望队踢成1比1，随后以点球4比3获胜夺冠。

en.s: On February 25, 2012, KSW 18: Unfinished Sympathy took place at Orlen Arena in Płock, Poland.

zh.t: KSW第18期赛事在普沃茨克举行
zh.s: 2012年2月25日，KSW第18期综合格斗赛事在波兰普沃茨克的奥伦竞技馆举行。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on 24 and 25 February 2013 to determine the 630 members of the Chamber of Deputies and the 315 elective members of the Senate of the Republic for the 17th Italian Parliament.

zh.s: 意大利于2013年2月24日至25日举行大选，选出第17届议会众议院630名议员，以及共和国参议院315名民选议员。

en.s: The 2013 Lombard regional election took place on 24 and 25 February 2013 and was the first snap election in Lombard political history, and the first one paired with a general election. The 10th term of the Regional Council was chosen.

zh.s: 意大利伦巴第大区于2013年2月24日至25日举行选举，选出第十届大区议会。这是伦巴第政治史上首次提前举行的选举，也是首次与全国大选同时举行。

en.s: The Lazio regional election of 2013 took place in Lazio, Italy, on 24–25 February 2013. Renata Polverini of The People of Freedom (PdL), who was elected president in 2010, was toppled by an expense scandal in October 2012 which led to her resignation. After that, the candidate of Democratic Party (PD) seemed a shoo-in for victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 拉齐奥大区于2013年2月24日至25日举行选举。2010年当选大区主席、自由人民党成员雷娜塔·波尔韦里尼因开支丑闻于2012年10月下台并辞职。民主党候选人一度被看好胜选。

en.t: Park Geun-hye begins her presidency in South Korea
en.s: On February 25, 2013, Park Geun-hye began her term as president of South Korea.

zh.s: 2013年2月25日，朴槿惠开始担任韩国总统。

en.s: The Molise regional election of 2013 took place on 24–25 February 2013, after that the 2011–2016 legislature was prematurely dissolved due to irregularities in the 2011 regional election. Paolo di Laura Frattura of the Democratic Party was elected president and the center-left performed approximately 16 points better than the center-left list for the Chamber of Deputies in the general election held the same day.

zh.s: 莫利塞大区于2013年2月24日至25日举行选举。2011至2016届大区议会因2011年大区选举违规而提前解散，因此举行了此次选举。民主党候选人保罗·迪·劳拉·弗拉图拉当选主席；中左翼阵营的得票率比同日举行的众议院大选中中左翼党派名单高约16个百分点。

en.s: General elections were held in Jamaica on 25 February 2016. The elections were largely a contest between the governing People's National Party (PNP) and the opposition Jamaica Labour Party (JLP). The result was a narrow victory for the Jamaica Labour Party, which won 32 of the 63 seats. One political commentator described the poll as "the closest election Jamaica has ever had". The winning vote share of the Jamaica Labour Party was the lowest vote-share for a winning party since 1962, when the JLP won 50.0% of the vote, and the narrowest majority in the House of Representatives since 1949.

zh.s: 牙买加于2016年2月25日举行大选，主要由执政的人民民族党与反对党牙买加工党角逐。工党赢得63席中的32席，以微弱优势获胜。一名政治评论者称这是“牙买加有史以来最接近的选举”。工党的得票率是自1962年该党以50.0%选票获胜以来，胜选政党的最低得票率，取得的众议院多数优势也是1949年以来最小的。

en.s: On February 25, 2016, three people were killed and fourteen others injured in a series of shootings in Newton and Hesston, Kansas, including in and outside an Excel Industries building. The shooter, identified as Excel employee Cedric Larry Ford, was then killed by a responding police officer.

zh.s: 2016年2月25日，美国堪萨斯州牛顿及赫斯顿接连发生枪击，包括Excel Industries公司一座建筑内外的枪击，造成3人死亡、14人受伤。枪手被确认为该公司员工塞德里克·拉里·福特，随后被赶到现场的警员击毙。

en.t: 2017 Delaware's 10th state senate district special election
en.s: On February 25, 2017, voters in the 10th district of the Delaware Senate voted in a special election to fill the seat left vacant by Democrat Bethany Hall-Long, the previous incumbent, who had resigned at the beginning of the year after having been elected lieutenant governor the preceding November.

zh.t: 2017年特拉华州参议院第十选区特别选举
zh.s: 2017年2月25日，特拉华州参议院第十选区举行特别选举，填补民主党议员贝瑟妮·霍尔-朗留下的空缺。她于前一年11月当选副州长，并在年初辞去州参议员职务。

en.s: The 2017 Mount Albert by-election was a New Zealand by-election held in the Mount Albert electorate on 25 February 2017 during the 51st New Zealand Parliament. The seat was vacated following the resignation of David Shearer, a former Leader of the New Zealand Labour Party. The by-election was avoided by all right and centre-right parties, and turnout was low.

zh.s: 2017年2月25日，新西兰第51届议会任期内，艾伯特山选区举行补选。新西兰工党前党魁戴维·希勒辞职，导致议席空缺。所有右翼和中右翼政党均未参选，投票率较低。

en.s: The 2017 Democratic National Committee chairmanship election was held on February 25, 2017, at the Westin Peachtree Plaza Hotel in Atlanta to determine the next chairperson of the Democratic National Committee (DNC). It was the first contested DNC chair election since 1985. Tom Perez and Keith Ellison emerged as the favored candidates of the majority of DNC members.

zh.t: 2017年美国民主党全国委员会主席选举
zh.s: 美国民主党全国委员会于2017年2月25日在亚特兰大威斯汀桃树广场酒店选举新主席。这是自1985年以来首次有竞争的主席选举。汤姆·佩雷斯和基思·埃利森成为多数委员会成员看好的候选人。

en.s: Chang'an Ford 2017 Chinese FA Super Cup (Chinese: 长安福特2017中国足球协会超级杯) was the 15th Chinese FA Super Cup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Chinese Super League and FA Cup competitions. The match was played at Chongqing Olympic Sports Center on 25 February 2017, and contested by league and cup double winners Guangzhou Evergrande Taobao and league runners-up Jiangsu Suning.

zh.s: 长安福特2017中国足协超级杯是第15届中国足协超级杯，由上赛季中超联赛和足协杯冠军对阵。比赛于2017年2月25日在重庆奥体中心举行，由联赛和足协杯双料冠军广州恒大淘宝对阵联赛亚军江苏苏宁。

en.t: K-1 stages its lightweight championship tournament in Tokyo
en.s: On February 25, 2017, K-1 held its World GP lightweight championship tournament at Yoyogi National Gymnasium in Tokyo, Japan.

zh.t: K-1在东京举行轻量级冠军锦标赛
zh.s: 2017年2月25日，K-1在日本东京的代代木国立体育馆举行世界大奖赛轻量级冠军锦标赛。

en.s: On February 25, 2018, WWE held its Elimination Chamber professional wrestling event at T-Mobile Arena in Paradise, Nevada, United States.

zh.s: 2018年2月25日，WWE在美国内华达州帕拉代斯的T-Mobile体育馆举办“密室淘汰赛”职业摔角赛事。

en.s: The 2018 EFL Cup final (also known as the 2018 Carabao Cup final for sponsorship reasons) was the final association football match of the 2017–18 EFL Cup that took place on 25 February 2018 at Wembley Stadium. It was the first League Cup final contested under the "Carabao Cup" name following the sponsorship of Carabao Energy Drink. It was contested between Manchester City and Arsenal, and won 3–0 by Manchester City.

zh.s: 2018年英格兰足球联赛杯决赛因赞助原因也称2018年卡拉宝杯决赛，于2018年2月25日在温布利球场举行，是2017—2018赛季联赛杯的决赛。这是赛事首次以“卡拉宝杯”名义举行。曼城对阵阿森纳，并以3比0获胜。

en.s: The 2018 Tyrolean state election was held on 25 February 2018 to elect the members of the Landtag of Tyrol. The conservative Austrian People's Party (ÖVP) placed first with 44.3% of votes, a 4.9 percentage point swing. The centre-left Social Democratic Party of Austria (SPÖ) recovered somewhat from its worst ever result in 2013, rising 3.5 points to 17.2%. The Freedom Party of Austria (FPÖ) also made gains.

zh.s: 蒂罗尔州于2018年2月25日举行选举，选出州议会议员。保守派奥地利人民党以44.3%的得票率位居第一，得票率上升4.9个百分点。中左翼奥地利社会民主党从2013年的历史最低点回升，得票率上升3.5个百分点，达到17.2%。奥地利自由党也有所增长。

en.s: The 68th annual Berlin International Film Festival took place from 15 to 25 February 2018. German filmmaker Tom Tykwer served as Jury President. American film director Wes Anderson's animated film Isle of Dogs opened the festival, becoming first animated film to open the fest. Romanian film Touch Me Not written and directed by Adina Pintilie won the Golden Bear, which also served as the closing night film.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第68届柏林国际电影节于2018年2月15日至25日举行，德国电影人汤姆·提克威担任评审团主席。美国导演韦斯·安德森执导的动画片《犬之岛》开幕；这是首部担任柏林电影节开幕片的动画电影。阿迪娜·平蒂列执导的罗马尼亚电影《不要碰我》获金熊奖，并作为闭幕片放映。

en.s: A by-election was held in the federal riding of York—Simcoe in Ontario on February 25, 2019, following the resignation of incumbent Conservative MP Peter Van Loan. After 15 years in Parliament, the former Leader of the Official Opposition announced that he would resign his seat. The by-election occurred alongside two others; Outremont and Burnaby South. The seat was held for the Conservatives by Scot Davidson.

zh.t: 2019年约克—锡姆科联邦选区补选
zh.s: 2019年2月25日，加拿大安大略省约克—锡姆科联邦选区举行补选，原因是现任保守党议员彼得·范洛恩辞职。原文称这位曾任官方反对党领袖的议员，在国会任职15年后宣布辞去议席。补选与奥特蒙及本拿比南两个选区同日进行，斯科特·戴维森为保守党保住议席。

en.s: A by-election was held in the federal riding of Burnaby South on February 25, 2019 following the resignation of incumbent New Democratic MP Kennedy Stewart on September 14, 2018. Jagmeet Singh, the federal leader of the NDP since October 1, 2017, won the by-election after having served as his party's leader without a seat in the House of Commons for over a year.

zh.s: 加拿大本拿比南联邦选区于2019年2月25日举行补选，填补新民主党议员肯尼迪·斯图尔特于2018年9月14日辞职留下的空缺。自2017年10月1日起担任联邦新民主党党魁的驵勉诚赢得补选。他此前已担任党魁一年多，却一直没有下议院议席。

en.s: General elections were held in the British Virgin Islands on 25 February 2019. For the first time, four parties with at least one incumbent member were contesting an election. The result was a decisive victory for the Virgin Islands Party, which won eight of the 13 elected seats. The ruling National Democratic Party won only three seats, with party leader Myron Walwyn losing his seat.

zh.s: 英属维尔京群岛于2019年2月25日举行大选，首次有四个各自至少拥有一名现任议员的政党参选。维尔京群岛党在13个民选议席中赢得8席，取得明确胜利。执政的民族民主党仅获3席，党魁迈伦·沃尔温也丢掉议席。

en.s: A by-election was held in the federal riding of Outremont in Quebec on February 25, 2019 following the resignation of incumbent New Democratic MP Tom Mulcair. After 12 years in Parliament, the former Leader of the Official Opposition announced that he would resign his seat. The seat was gained by the Liberal Party of Canada, with Rachel Bendayan winning and becoming the new MP.

zh.s: 2019年2月25日，加拿大魁北克省奥特蒙联邦选区举行补选。现任新民主党议员、曾任官方反对党领袖的汤姆·马尔凯尔，在国会任职12年后宣布辞职。加拿大自由党的蕾切尔·本达扬当选，取得该议席。

en.s: The 2021 Armenian political crisis was an alleged military coup attempt by the Armed Forces of Armenia led by the Chief of the General Staff of the Armenian Armed Forces Onik Gasparyan against the government of Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan. Pashinyan accused Gasparyan and 40 other high-ranking military officers of attempting a coup after they published a statement calling for Pashinyan's resignation on 25 February 2021.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2021年亚美尼亚政治危机是亚美尼亚武装部队涉嫌发动的未遂政变，由武装部队总参谋长奥尼克·加斯帕良领导。2021年2月25日，加斯帕良和其他40名高级军官发表声明，要求总理尼科尔·帕希尼扬辞职；帕希尼扬指责他们试图发动政变。

en.t: India and Pakistan announce renewed observance of the ceasefire
en.s: On February 25, 2021, India and Pakistan announced that their military operations chiefs had agreed to strictly observe existing ceasefire agreements along the Line of Control and other sectors, effective from midnight February 24–25.

zh.t: 印度与巴基斯坦宣布重新严格遵守停火安排
zh.s: 2021年2月25日，印度与巴基斯坦宣布，两国军事行动负责人同意从2月24日至25日午夜起，严格遵守实际控制线及其他地段的现有停火安排。

en.s: Bellator 275: Mousasi vs. Vanderford was a mixed martial arts event produced by Bellator MMA that took place on February 25, 2022, at the 3Arena in Dublin, Ireland.

zh.s: “Bellator 275：穆萨西对范德福德”是Bellator MMA举办的综合格斗赛事，于2022年2月25日在爱尔兰都柏林的3Arena举行。

en.s: On 25 February 2022, the Russian air base in Millerovo, Rostov Oblast, Russia, was attacked by Ukrainian forces during the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine. According to some Ukrainian officials, Ukrainian military forces attacked the Millerovo air base with OTR-21 Tochka missiles, destroying Russian Air Force planes and setting the airbase on fire.

zh.t: 米列罗沃空军基地遇袭
zh.s: 2022年2月25日，乌克兰军队袭击了位于俄罗斯罗斯托夫州的米列罗沃空军基地。当时俄罗斯正在入侵乌克兰。据乌克兰部分官员称，乌军使用OTR-21“圆点”导弹袭击基地，摧毁了俄罗斯空军飞机并引发火灾。

en.t: Russian forces renew the assault on Antonov Airport
en.s: On February 25, 2022, Russian forces renewed their assault on Antonov Airport at Hostomel, Ukraine, following the previous day’s airborne attack and Ukrainian counterattack.

zh.t: 俄军再次进攻安东诺夫机场
zh.s: 2022年2月25日，俄军再次进攻乌克兰霍斯托梅尔的安东诺夫机场。前一天，俄军曾发动空降突击，随后遭到乌军反击。

en.t: A missile strike on Rivne airport is reported
en.s: On February 25, 2022, a missile strike on Rivne airport in Ukraine was reported during Russia’s full-scale invasion. This record concerns that initial reported attack rather than all later strikes in the region.

zh.t: 乌克兰里夫内机场传出遭导弹袭击的消息
zh.s: 2022年2月25日，俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰期间，传出乌克兰里夫内机场遭导弹袭击的消息。此条记录当天报道的袭击，不包括此后该地区发生的其他空袭。

en.s: ONE: Full Circle was a Combat sport event produced by ONE Championship that took place on February 25, 2022, at the Singapore Indoor Stadium in Kallang, Singapore.

zh.s: ONE：全面出击是一场由ONE冠军赛主办的格斗赛事，于2022年2月25日在新加坡加冷的新加坡室内体育馆举行。

en.s: The 2023 Nigerian House of Representatives elections were held on 25 February 2023 where voters elected members of the House of Representatives using first-past-the-post voting in all 360 federal constituencies. The last regular House elections for all districts were in 2019. Other federal elections, including the Senate elections and the presidential election, held on the same date while state elections were held two weeks afterwards on 18 March.

zh.s: 尼日利亚于2023年2月25日举行众议院选举，在全部360个联邦选区采用得票最多者当选的方式选出议员。此前一次所有选区同时进行的定期众议院选举是在2019年。参议院和总统选举等其他联邦选举也在同日举行，各州选举于3月18日举行；原文将后者记为“两周后”，与日期间隔不符。

en.s: A Presidential election was held on 25 February 2023 in Nigeria to elect the president and vice president. All Progressives Congress (APC) nominee Bola Tinubu defeated Atiku Abubakar of the Peoples Democratic Party and Peter Obi of Labour Party. Party's primary elections were conducted between 4 April and 9 June 2022; Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) nominated Atiku Abubakar while All Progressives Congress (APC) chose Bola Tinubu as their nominee.

zh.s: 尼日利亚于2023年2月25日举行总统选举，选出总统及副总统。全体进步大会党候选人博拉·蒂努布击败人民民主党的阿提库·阿布巴卡尔及工党的彼得·奥比。各党初选于2022年4月4日至6月9日进行，人民民主党提名阿提库·阿布巴卡尔，全体进步大会党选出博拉·蒂努布。

en.s: The 2023 Nigerian Senate elections were held on 25 February 2023 in all 109 senatorial districts where voters elected senators using first-past-the-post voting. The last regular senatorial elections for all districts were in 2019. Other federal elections, including the elections to the House of Representatives and the presidential election, were also held on the same date while state elections was held two weeks afterwards on 11 March.

zh.s: 尼日利亚于2023年2月25日举行参议院选举，在全部109个选区采用得票最多者当选的方式选出参议员。此前一次所有选区同时进行的定期参议院选举是在2019年。众议院和总统选举等其他联邦选举也在同日举行。原文记载，各州选举在两周后的3月11日举行。

en.s: A special election was held in Cavite's 7th congressional district on February 25, 2023, to fill the district's vacant seat in the House of Representatives of the Philippines for the remainder of the 19th Congress. The vacancy arose when Jesus Crispin Remulla, the district's representative, opted to not take his seat in the 19th Congress to serve as the Secretary of Justice in the administration of President Bongbong Marcos.

zh.t: 2023年甲米地省第七国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 菲律宾甲米地省第七国会选区于2023年2月25日举行特别选举，填补该选区在第19届国会众议院剩余任期的空缺。原当选议员赫苏斯·克里斯平·雷穆利亚选择不在第19届国会就任，转而出任小费迪南德·马科斯总统政府的司法部长，因而出现空缺。

en.s: Bellator 291: Amosov vs. Storley 2 (also known as Bellator Dublin) was a mixed martial arts event produced by Bellator MMA, that took place on February 25, 2023, at the 3Arena in Dublin, Ireland.

zh.s: “Bellator 291：阿莫索夫对斯托利二番战”，又称“Bellator都柏林”，是Bellator MMA举办的综合格斗赛事，于2023年2月25日在爱尔兰都柏林的3Arena举行。

en.s: General elections were held in Nigeria on 25 February 2023 to elect the president and vice president and members of the Senate and House of Representatives. Incumbent president Muhammadu Buhari was term-limited and could not seek re-election for a third term. This election was seen as the tightest race since the end of military rule in 1999.

zh.s: 尼日利亚于2023年2月25日举行大选，选出总统、副总统及参众两院议员。现任总统穆罕默杜·布哈里受到任期限制，不能争取第三届连任。这被视为1999年军事统治结束以来竞争最激烈的一次选举。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Muniz vs. Allen
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Muniz vs. Allen (also known as UFC Fight Night 220, UFC on ESPN+ 78 and UFC Vegas 70) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on February 25, 2023, at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：穆尼兹对艾伦
zh.s: “UFC格斗之夜：穆尼兹对艾伦”，又称UFC格斗之夜220、UFC on ESPN+ 78及UFC拉斯维加斯70，是终极格斗冠军赛举办的综合格斗赛事，于2023年2月25日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex场馆举行。恩特普赖斯属于拉斯维加斯都会区。

en.t: 2023 Nigerian Senate elections in Ogun State
en.s: The 2023 Nigerian Senate elections in Ogun State was held on 25 February 2023, to elect the 3 federal Senators from Ogun State, one from each of the state's three senatorial districts. The elections coincided with the 2023 presidential election, as well as other elections to the Senate and elections to the House of Representatives; with state elections being held two weeks later.

zh.t: 2023年尼日利亚奥贡州参议院选举
zh.s: 奥贡州于2023年2月25日举行参议院选举，为该州三个参议员选区各选出一名联邦参议员，共三人。选举与2023年总统选举以及其他参议院和众议院选举同时举行；州级选举则在两周后举行。

en.t: 2023 Nigerian presidential election in Kano State
en.s: The 2023 Nigerian presidential election in Kano State was held on 25 February 2023 as part of the nationwide 2023 Nigerian presidential election to elect the president and vice president of Nigeria. Other federal elections, including elections to the House of Representatives and the Senate, were also held on the same date while state elections were held two weeks afterward on 11 March.

zh.t: 2023年尼日利亚卡诺州总统选举
zh.s: 卡诺州于2023年2月25日举行总统选举，是尼日利亚全国总统选举的一部分，选出尼日利亚总统和副总统。众议院和参议院等其他联邦选举也在同日举行，州级选举则于两周后的3月11日举行。

en.t: 2023 Nigerian presidential election in Osun State
en.s: The 2023 Nigerian presidential election in Osun State was held on 25 February 2023 as part of the nationwide 2023 Nigerian presidential election to elect the president and vice president of Nigeria. Other federal elections, including elections to the House of Representatives and the Senate, were also held on the same date while state elections were held two weeks afterward on 11 March.

zh.t: 2023年尼日利亚奥孙州总统选举
zh.s: 奥孙州于2023年2月25日举行总统选举，是尼日利亚全国总统选举的一部分，选出尼日利亚总统和副总统。众议院和参议院等其他联邦选举也在同日举行，州级选举则于两周后的3月11日举行。

en.t: 2023 Nigerian Senate elections in Abia State
en.s: The 2023 Nigerian Senate elections in Abia State were held on 25 February 2023, to elect the 3 federal Senators from Abia State, one from each of the state's three senatorial districts. The elections will coincide with the 2023 presidential election, as well as other elections to the Senate, and elections to the House of Representatives; with state elections being held two weeks later.

zh.s: 阿比亚州于2023年2月25日举行参议院选举，为该州三个参议员选区各选出一名联邦参议员，共三人。选举与2023年总统选举以及其他参议院和众议院选举同时举行；州级选举则在两周后举行。

en.t: 2023 Nigerian Senate elections in Ebonyi State

zh.t: 2023年尼日利亚埃博尼州参议院选举
zh.s: 埃博尼州于2023年2月25日举行参议院选举，为该州三个参议员选区各选出一名联邦参议员，共三人。选举与2023年总统选举以及其他参议院和众议院选举同时举行；州级选举则在两周后举行。
